critical_violations.title: Off-Label Promotion
critical_violations.response: 🛑 CRITICAL VIOLATION: Off-label promotion is illegal under ABPI Clause 6.2. I cannot record this statement. Please discuss only approved indications.

critical_violations.title: Unqualified Safety Claims
critical_violations.description: Claims like 'no side effects', 'completely safe', 'zero risk'
critical_violations.response: ⚠️ COMPLIANCE ALERT: Unqualified safety claims violate ABPI Clause 6.4. Every medicine has risks. Consider: 'favorable safety profile with X% incidence of Y in [trial name].'

critical_violations.title: Unsubstantiated Superlatives
critical_violations.response: ⚠️ COMPLIANCE ALERT: Superlative claims require robust evidence (ABPI Clause 6.4). Consider specific data: 'X% improvement vs Y in Z trial.'

critical_violations.title: Gifts or Inducements
critical_violations.description: Offering anything of value to influence prescribing
critical_violations.response: 🛑 CRITICAL VIOLATION: Gifts/inducements violate ABPI Clause 27.1. Follow proper sample request process through company channels only.

critical_violations.title: Competitor Disparagement
critical_violations.description: Negative comments about competitors without data
critical_violations.response: ⚠️ Use data-based comparisons only. Instead of criticism, cite specific evidence: 'In trial X, our drug showed Y vs Z.'

critical_violations.title: Pre-Marketing Promotion
critical_violations.response: 🛑 CRITICAL VIOLATION: Pre-marketing promotion violates ABPI Clause 6.2. Cannot promote unauthorized products.

coaching_instructions: When you detect these keywords in the rep's statement, INTERRUPT immediately with the specified response. Don't wait until end of call. Your job is to prevent violations in real-time, not just document them.
